shared_elements: horizontal band of repeated geometric motif (arcs in A, chevrons/zigzags in B)
large upright slab bearing a design concentrated in its upper part
schematic outlined forms enclosed by a framing contour or register line
repeated arch/curve shapes in a row
justification: The only real correspondence is generic: each upright slab carries its design in the upper zone, organised with a horizontal band of repeated geometric units (a row of arcs/scallops in A, a chevron band in B) beneath or between other motifs. Otherwise the content is quite different: B is densely figural, with quadrupeds in a row, birds in profile, a snake-like creature, a small anthropomorph and a plant motif, while A shows no living creature at all, only an abstract arched frame enclosing an angular, possibly boat- or vessel-like linear device.
